xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5292: Workflow redesign E: slim top bar (agents menu, one Needs-you count, health dot) and shared counts

plan.title: Workflow redesign E: slim top bar (agents menu, one Needs-you count, health dot) and shared counts
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The app bar is eleven unrelated pills, and three surfaces count 'needs you' with three different rules (Decisions badge, Flywheel badge, Home card) while the agents pill and the Home page count running agents differently, so the numbers disagree.
narratives.Proposal: Replace the bar's right side with the mockup's agents menu, Needs-you button, health dot (whose popover hosts System health, GitHub quota, auto-resume, stopped agents and Cloister controls as inline sections) and theme toggle, plus four exception chips that render only while abnormal; make the search box open the palette and the crumb read project / active tab; switch the top bar and the Home page to child S's useNeedsYouItems and useAgentsWorking selectors, and prove agreement with one test.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not change the left column, Sidebar.tsx, the brand placement or the window-spanning layout (child F).
- Do not remove the Activity-feed (History) toggle or the Awareness column (child F).
- Do not edit CommandPalette.tsx or add files to the palette (child B).
- Do not change project Home, CommandDeck/ProjectOverview.tsx or Stage files (child G / B).
- Do not change the system-notices row or any banner above the bar.
- Do not change useAgentsWorking, useNeedsYouItems, projectOf or WorkingRow.
- Do not change other count surfaces: MobileNeedsYou, God View, pipeline-helpers, DecisionsPanel, pipeline-state.
- Do not change UpdateDialog's running-agent count.
- Do not add polling intervals or new server routes.
- Do not raise or add any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row.
- No mobile/narrow layout work beyond not overflowing at 1280 px.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the Activity-feed (History) toggle in the top bar in this child (E-D3).
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent §7 gives its replacement (/activity Feed tab) to child F; removing it here would leave the off-deck feed unreachable until F merges, violating parent D-13/D-14.

autoDecisions.summary: No brand/logo in the top bar in this child (E-D4).
autoDecisions.rationale: The window-spanning top bar is child F's App.tsx layout change; Sidebar.tsx still shows the logo until F.

autoDecisions.summary: Add 'Auto-resume frozen' and 'N stopped' exception chips beyond §6.7's two (E-D9).
autoDecisions.rationale: DeaconPauseBanner is mounted nowhere, so the bar's compact toggle is the only frozen signal, and Stop all freezes Deacon; the stopped pill is the only stopped-agents signal. §6.7's own rule is 'exceptions surface'.

autoDecisions.summary: Stale-build chip reads 'Build behind main' with a 'Run pan reload' title instead of 'Reload to update' (E-D10).
autoDecisions.rationale: The chip reports the server build lagging origin/main; a browser reload does not fix it and NewBuildBanner owns the browser-reload case.

autoDecisions.summary: Low-cost mode and stale build are chips only, not popover sections.
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent §7 row for the top bar assigns them to 'exception chips (low-cost, stale)' and the popover to freeze, restart, quota, health and system menu.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep SystemHealthPill's file, name and test id; it renders the dot and takes children sections (E-D14).
autoDecisions.rationale: 16 pinned tests query data-testid system-health-pill and its dialog; a rename adds churn without behavior.

autoDecisions.summary: Health popover hosts inline sections; outside clicks inside any role=dialog/alertdialog are ignored; Cloister's restart-config modal gains role=dialog (E-D5, E-D6).
autoDecisions.rationale: Nested absolute popovers clip inside a scrolling popover, and CloisterStatusBar portals sub-dialogs to body which would otherwise close the popover.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete RunningAgentsPill(+test), DecisionsIndicator and SystemMenu(+test); remove GitHubQuotaPill component (E-D12, E-D13, E-D13a).
autoDecisions.rationale: Their only consumer is AppChrome; the test-skip gate's deleted-subject exemption covers tests deleted with their subjects, and their behaviors are re-tested in the new components.

autoDecisions.summary: countRunningAgents stays in App.tsx for UpdateDialog only (E-D2).
autoDecisions.rationale: UpdateDialog counts agents an update restart would interrupt, a different question from agents working; App must not subscribe to slices (PAN-4560).

autoDecisions.summary: Search box opens the palette with a global placeholder; child B changes PALETTE_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER when files land (E-D15).
autoDecisions.rationale: CommandPalette.tsx is child B's file and B lands after E; the palette is global so the placeholder no longer names the project.

autoDecisions.summary: Agents menu joins store agents and the conversations query for model and age; WorkingRow is unchanged (E-D17).
autoDecisions.rationale: Child S's WorkingRow has no model or time; extending the shared selector is outside this child's scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs you and agents controls are always visible; neutral at zero (E-D18).
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent §6.7: amber only when N > 0; the mockup shows both controls permanently; the agents menu is also the way to the Agents page.

autoDecisions.summary: All CI-subset additions happen in one ci-subset item.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the parallel component items file-disjoint so subagents never edit the same file.
